bio.text: Jena Griswold is Colorado's Secretary of State, first elected in 2018 and reelected in 2022, and is the Democratic Party candidate for Attorney General in 2026.
She holds a B.A. from Whitman College and a J.D. from the University of Pennsylvania Law School, and is a graduate of Estes Park High School.

Before becoming Secretary of State she practiced international anti-corruption law, worked as a voter protection attorney, and served as director of the Governor of Colorado's Washington, D.C. office.
